meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能按代码结构而非文本来搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种语言。可查找特定形状的代码、批量替换写法（如 console.log 改 logger.info），并先预览改动、统计受影响文件数。
howto.when: 当你要求按代码结构查找或改写时触发，例如“找出所有带某参数的函数”“把 console.log 换成 logger.info”“去掉 as any 断言”。纯文本搜索（如字符串、注释）不会触发。

say.text: 查找所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按AST结构搜索，返回文件位置和匹配数

say.text: 把项目里 console.log(x) 都改成 logger.info(x)
say.note: 先预览改动，确认后再应用

say.text: 扫描并应用 rules 目录的 YAML 规则
say.note: 运行代码检查并输出违规位置

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code by structure, not text, across 25 languages. It finds code shapes, batch-replaces patterns (e.g., console.log to logger.info), previews changes, and reports affected file counts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on structural code search/rewrite requests, e.g., find functions with a given parameter, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip as any. Plain-text searches (strings, comments) don't trigger it.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter
say_en.note: Searches by AST structure, returns locations and match counts.

say_en.text: Rewrite console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in the repo
say_en.note: Previews changes first; applies only after confirmation.

say_en.text: Scan and apply YAML rules in the rules directory
say_en.note: Runs code checks and reports violations.
